checks.meaning: The briefing left out a fact the decision turned on. An underwriter reading it would not know why the case was referred.
The briefing stated a figure that is not in, or derivable from, the case file.
The briefing blamed a field with no bearing on the outcome, pointing the underwriter at noise.
The briefing did not say correctly what would change the outcome.
The briefing stated a comparison that is false — a figure above a threshold described as below it, or the reverse.
The briefing said a limit was breached, or met, and its own figure says otherwise.

conditions: numeric_fidelity: the same case got different verdicts across repeats for 45% of cases (limit 10%).
decoy_citation: the same case got different verdicts across repeats for 35% of cases (limit 10%).
flip_accuracy: the same case got different verdicts across repeats for 15% of cases (limit 10%).
comparison_fidelity: pass rate 90% is below the GO threshold of 98%.
comparison_fidelity: the same case got different verdicts across repeats for 30% of cases (limit 10%).
claim_consistency: the same case got different verdicts across repeats for 35% of cases (limit 10%).

risks.label: Figure worked out wrongly
risks.why: The assistant worked a figure out itself and got it wrong.

risks.label: Threshold stated the wrong way round
risks.why: The assistant compared a figure with a policy threshold and got the direction wrong, or said a limit was breached when its own figure says it was not.

risks.label: Irrelevant field blamed
risks.why: The assistant blamed a field that has no bearing on the outcome.

not_tested.why: This pack tests behaviour on constructed cases. It says nothing about the provenance or representativeness of the tested system's training data.
We log our assessment, not the deployed system's operation.
Organisational, not testable by a pack.

not_tested.what: Whether the lending decision itself is right. The underwriter decides; that is verified by the loan book, months or years later.
Real applications. Every case is constructed so the answer is known; results describe these cases. A failure proves a problem exists; a pass does not prove there is none.
Fairness across groups of applicants. That needs population data and a definition the bank owns.
Scores from readability are a model's opinion; they are reported, not used in this decision.

thresholds_note: Thresholds from evidence/thresholds.yaml. They belong to the bank's model risk team; change them there and re-write the evidence.
